title: RateLimitsView
description: `GET /engines/claude/usage/rate-limits`: the rate-limit windows of the account the Claude CLI is signed in to, each as it was last observed on the stream (plan 16, D-09). The account is the machine's, shared by every user of this installation — never real-time: a window with no reading yet is simply absent from the list.

displayName.description: The server's own label for a per-model window (`"Fable"`, say) — absent for every other window, which a client already has a translation for by `kind`.
